column2: Mentawai words in the Austronesian Comparative Dictionary (Blust, Trussel and Smith; from Morris 1900): English glosses and the proto-forms they come from (CC BY 4.0)
I; 1sg postnominal possessive pronoun: my < PAN *-ku '1sg genitive (marker of non-subject agency and possession; my; by me)'
you, your < PAN *-nu₂ '2sg possessor and non-subject agent'
prefix indicating the completion of an event e.g. bala 'come out', a-bala 'it is out' < PMP *ha-₁ 'adjectival prefix for adjectives of measure'
take along with, bring hither < PMP *ambit 'seize with the hands'
fetch, get, pick up < PAN *ala 'take, get, fetch, obtain; marry'; PAN *alaq₁ 'fetch, get, take'
corpulent, easy, comfortable (given by [Morris 1900](Source#cldf:morris1900) under āma 'father') < PWMP *ama-an '(gloss uncertain)'
posts upon which a house rests; posts that support the veranda of a house; posts under a sleeping platform < PAN *SadiRi 'housepost'
fetch water < PMP *asu₂ 'fetch water, scoop up water'; PMP *qasu₁ 'fetch water, scoop up water'
calf of the leg < PMP *bities 'lower leg (below the knee); calf of the leg'
excavation, hole, den < PMP *baŋbaŋ₃ 'cavity, pit, den; to excavate a pit'

mangrove < PMP *wakat 'mangrove root'
trunk (of trees) < PMP *bataŋ 'tree trunk, fallen tree, log; stem of a plant; body; corpse; self; bridge of the nose; most important or preeminent thing; main course of a river; mushroom or bracket fungus that grows on tree trunks or decaying logs'
axe; chop with an axe < PWMP *baliuŋ 'adze, axe'
brother, sister < PMP *baliw₁ 'dual division, moiety == cluster (a) answer, oppose, opposite side or part; partner, friend, enemy'
exist, be present < PMP *wada 'be, exist, have; wealthy; not exist, not have'
stretch, put under tension (a bow, mousetrap, etc.); tension < PWMP *betek₂ 'stretch, put under tension'
burst, crack, explode, leap, spring, gush, shoot, shoot off < PMP *betu₂ 'explode; explosion (as of a volcano)'
cape; bend in a river; circumnavigate a cape or a bend in the river < PMP *biluk 'to wind, curve, turn to the side; to tack, sail into the wind'
to tear, tear up; a tear or rip in something < PAN *biriC 'to tear, rip'
lower leg, calf of the leg < PMP *bities 'lower leg (below the knee); calf of the leg'
fruit; husk; flower; testicle; part of the breast tattooing; ZC (nephew or niece) < PAN *buaq 'fruit'
roof; cover the roof; deck of a boat < PMP *bubuŋ₁ 'ridge of the roof; ridge of a mountain, peak; deck of a boat; cover the ridgepole with thatch'
wash, rinse out < PMP *buRiq 'wash, as the hands'
body hair, feather < PMP *bulu₁ 'body hair; fur; feather; down; floss on plant stems; color; type, kind'
sap, resin; to stick or adhere < PWMP *eket 'stick, adhere'
stick tight in something (also used of difficult childbirth) < PAN *qipit 'pincer of crustaceans; tongs; press together, pinch, squeeze'
brother-in-law, sister-in-law (woman speaking) < PAN *idas₁ 'affine of Ego's generation'
in, at, to, towards, from here, among, out of < PAN *ka₃ 'oblique case marker for plural personal names'
1pl. excl., we, us < PAN *k-ami '1pl. excl. nominative pronoun, we (exclusive)'
kind of fish < PAN *kaNasay 'a fish: the mullet'
say; believe; word < PWMP *kua₂ 'whatchamacallit, filler for word that cannot be recollected'
skin, bark < PAN *kuliC 'rind, peeling of fruits or tubers'
louse < PMP *kuman 'tiny parasite on the body, itch mite, chicken louse'
red sky of morning and evening < PAN *laŋiC 'sky'
tail feathers of a fowl < PWMP *lawi-lawi 'something that resembles a tail feather (?)'
sky, heaven < PMP *banua 'inhabited land, territory supporting the life of a community'
lift (Pagai, Sipora, southern Siberut) < PWMP *aŋkat 'lift, raise, pick up'

eye, face; open the eyes < PAN *maCa 'eye, focal point, center or most prominent part'
raw, uncooked; unripe < PMP *ma-hataq 'raw, uncooked'
window, door < PAN *maCa 'eye, focal point, center or most prominent part'
nipple of the breast < PAN *maCa 'eye, focal point, center or most prominent part'
anus < PAN *maCa 'eye, focal point, center or most prominent part'
opening of a quiver < PAN *maCa 'eye, focal point, center or most prominent part'
eye of a needle < PAN *maCa 'eye, focal point, center or most prominent part'
friction groove of a fireplow < PAN *maCa 'eye, focal point, center or most prominent part'
dead; death; die; kill; go out (cigarette); set (sun); become feeble (penis) < PAN *ma-aCay 'die; dead; eclipse of sun or moon'
the pomelo: Citrus grandis < PMP *muntay 'kind of citrus tree and its fruit'
the pomelo: Citrus grandis < PMP *muntay 'kind of citrus tree and its fruit'
to hit, beat < PMP *pak 'sound of a clap or smack'
ridgepole of a house < PMP *bubuŋ-an 'roof; ridge of the roof'
how much? how many? < PAN *pijax 'interrogative of quantity: how much?, how many?; adjective of indefinite quantity: some, several, a few'
to pick, choose; choosy, fastidious < PAN *piliq 'to choose, to select; to pick out'
umbilical cord; navel; lower point on a casting net < PMP *pusej 'navel, umbilicus; mid-point or center of something'

the owner; mushroom sp. < PMP *bataŋ 'tree trunk, fallen tree, log; stem of a plant; body; corpse; self; bridge of the nose; most important or preeminent thing; main course of a river; mushroom or bracket fungus that grows on tree trunks or decaying logs'
there < PAN *si ia₂ 'demonstrative pronoun and adverb: this, here; that, there'
pitfall or trail spikes made of sharpened < PMP *suja 'pitfall or trail spikes made of sharpened bamboo'
rope, string, cord < PAN *CaliS 'rope, cord, twine, string'
ripe, of fruit < PAN *tuqaS 'old, of people; primary forest, old forest'

a plant, Derris elliptica, Leguminosae, the sap of which is used as a poison to stun and catch fish; fish caught in this way < PAN *tubah 'a plant with roots that are pounded and put in rivers to stun fish: Derris elliptica'
bone < PAN *CuqelaN 'condylar bone; bone of fauna exclusive of fish'
‘suffix’ for numerals < PMP *ŋa 'linker for multiples of ten'
